acceptances.justification: The pinned Debian 13.6 DHI runtime has no vendor fix or verified VEX for this finding.
acceptances.impact: A successful non-blocking gzwrite exploit could corrupt the isolated task process heap and affect its integrity or availability.
acceptances.exploitability: No application call to gzwrite, gzprintf, or gzvprintf was found; the task has zero ingress and runs non-root with a read-only root filesystem.
acceptances.evidence: PR #338 CI run 34218267163 on 2026-09-08 has the same software package names and versions as Core release 33954661227. Its verified DHI VEX and Grype reports leave only the same zlib1g and zlib1g-dev CVE-2026-85091 findings, version 1:1.3.dfsg+really1.3.1-1+dhi2, not-fixed; fixable High/Critical is zero. Application code still has no gzwrite/gzprintf/gzvprintf calls and runtime exposure is unchanged. The oldest digest is replaced within the four-digest limit; the current production digest and original expiry are retained.
acceptances.reevaluation_conditions: Reevaluate when DHI publishes a new runtime digest, Debian publishes a fixed zlib package, verified VEX changes, or task exposure changes.
